notes: Clinic & account / My account: a Log out button now sits under “All changes saved” at the top, so it is easy to find on a phone.
Settings / My account: new “App update” box with “Check for updates” and “Update now”, so you can update the app yourself whenever a new version is available.
Accountant can now open Earnings with their own PIN (income, expenses, reports; staff and salaries are view only). Run supabase-update-accountant.sql once for the online version.
Only the owner (admin) sees Clinic & account. Dentists and the accountant get a small “My account” page: name, password, sound.

New Visits tab: one card per visit date with the treatment done, prescription, payment and note. Tap Edit to change a note (date, type, text, treatments done). The Details page shows the Last visit at the top with “+ Note for today”.

Welcome page: tapping Dental clinic or Dental hospital while you are already logged in now opens the “Create your clinic” form for a NEW one (type already chosen), instead of your existing clinic. “Back to my clinic” returns.
Prescriptions: new “Open file” button next to Print and Save PDF (also “Save & open file”, in the pharmacy list and for treatment records), so you can open the PDF as a file.
Appointments now open first after you log in.
Smart Help: tap the Help button, type what you need (for example “holiday”) and it shows where it is and takes you there.
Hospitals: choose Dental hospital to use departments. Every patient can have a department, and the list can be filtered.
Pharmacy: new prescriptions appear in the Pharmacy list; chosen staff get a pop-up and sound.
Laboratory: dentists send lab requests from the patient's Lab tab; the lab marks them done with a result.
Fixed a style line so all screens look correct.
Settings → background: choose the colour of the whole page, or your own photo.
Departments are now one box on the patient list; tap it to open all departments.
Orthodontics: new Ortho tab with records checklist, examination, cephalometric values, diagnosis, treatment plan, scanner and digital devices, clear aligners and visit log.
Pharmacy and lab staff each get their own login and see only their own list: no patient files, no phone numbers, no other menus. Pharmacy can print prescriptions.
Lab: the lab sets a stage (Received, In progress, Ready for try-in, Quality check, Delivered); every dentist gets a notification with the patient's name.
Pharmacy and lab staff get their own login and see only their own list.
Menu numbers removed; a red dot shows only when something is new.
Patient portal: in a patient's Details tab, create a PIN; the patient logs in with mobile number + PIN and sees only their appointments, prescriptions and lab work that is ready.
Only clinics approved by the app owner can be created (creation codes).
Removed people can no longer rejoin with an old invitation or create their own clinic.
Settings: choose the colour of the whole app.
